nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What does the analysis aim to achieve regarding EU forest policy?
nodes.answer: The analysis aims to invite readers to navigate the complexities of EU forest policy by unraveling worldviews and actor perspectives, ultimately facilitating improved dialogue among actors considering these heterogeneous worldviews.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Afforestation programs|Afforestation policy advocacy_qna_002
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: Which frameworks have been used to study EU forest policy and its actors?
nodes.answer: Frameworks used include discourse analysis, Advocacy Coalition Framework (ACF), Shifting Coalitions Theory (SCT), policy integration theories, Multi-Level Governance (MLG), and Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) Framework.
